title: Help with 3D models!
author: NoOneKnowsSatoshi
selftext: Hey guys! Mind helping me with character 3D models and assets generating tools you guys are using? Also what you are using for animation?

comments.author: Bulky_Blood_7362
comments.body:
For characters you best go with something like tripo, meshy, hunyuan3d etc.

I suggest to try hunyuan first as they give you free 20 models a day.

Then give the fbx to your ai agent to fix and rig it correctly

replies.author: NoOneKnowsSatoshi
replies.body: Thanks for your answer! I've been looking at meshy but never heard of hunyuan3D! Gonna look into it rn!

replies.author: Brewgazer
replies.body: I think there’s a blender add on for hunyuan

comments.author: Brewgazer
comments.body: If you are paying for Claude: download the blender mcp, get blender skills and have your ai train on them, generate a reference photo to feed Claude with free gpt, have it give you front back and side profiles. Feed it to Claude and tell it to make it in blender, have it animate it in blender after

replies.author: NoOneKnowsSatoshi
replies.body: Yeah I got a Max plan. Thanks a a lot, somehow I totally missed blender plugin!

replies.author: Brewgazer
replies.body: Be sure to find the right blender skills to give your agents first

replies.author: NoOneKnowsSatoshi
replies.body: Yeah doing research and downloading skills to test out let's see how it goes! Thanks for help!

replies.body: Can this be done with ChatGPT?

replies.body: Opus 5.5 gets better results and knows how to animate correctly
